bookdesc: NAHUM, whose name signifies A COMFORTER, was a native of Elcese, or Elcesai, supposed to be a little town in Galilee.  He prophesied, after the ten tribes were carried into captivity, and foretold the utter destruction of Ninive, by the Babylonians and Medes:  which happened in the reign of JOSIAS.

chapters.chapterdesc: The majesty of God, his goodness to his people, and severity to his enemies.
God sends his armies against Ninive to destroy it.
